name: ctx-kit
description: Session lifecycle toolkit for Claude Code: state lives on disk, sessions are disposable. 7 skills (ctx-init / ctx-kickoff / ctx-handoff / ctx-takeover / ctx-status / ctx-checkup / ctx-forhuman) + two hooks (a warning before auto-compact, and a once-per-turn context watermark reading that prints only when the session is past the line) + a cache-audit script + a digest subagent. The hooks only print locally; the scripts only read local session logs. 会话生命周期工具包：状态在盘上，会话可抛弃。
